headline: 11 Google ads for a franchise chain - while every outlet's local demand goes unadvertised.

contact.address: 35, K.R. Colony, Krishna Reddy Layout, Amarjyoti Layout, Domlur, Bengaluru 560071

ad_intro: Frozen Bottle (Munchbox Frozen Foods Pvt Ltd) is a Bengaluru-born dessert chain - milkshakes, sundae jars, boba, bubble tea, Belgian waffles - that scaled through a city plus master-franchise model, and it runs two brands: Frozen Bottle and Lubov Patisserie. Verified Google inventory: 11 live creatives. For a chain whose growth depends on franchise enquiries and outlet footfall, the paid engine is barely switched on: no store-radius campaigns, no structured franchise-enquiry funnel, and a second brand (Lubov) with no visible paid support at all.
ad_intelligence: 11 live creatives; advertiser Munchbox Frozen Foods Pvt Ltd.

Company-owned + franchise outlets, with dedicated franchise pages including 'Franchise by city' and 'Master franchise in India', plus corporate food booking - i.e. two revenue lines: consumer footfall and franchise sales.
Frozen Bottle plus Lubov Patisserie (lubov.in) - a premium patisserie brand with no visible paid activity in this pass.

35, K.R. Colony, Krishna Reddy Layout, Amarjyoti Layout, Domlur, Bengaluru 560071; franchise@frozenbottle.in / +91 9108131660 / +91 6366870312; partnership: vipul@frozenbottle.in; customer care 080-48669920, Mon-Fri 10am-6pm; cake orders +91 9108130460.
Footer links to frozenbottle.com/pages/faqs while /pages/faq returns a 404 - a broken link buyers hit from the footer today.
Dessert cafes compete on impulse and proximity; franchise brands compete for investor enquiries. Both demand types are addressable with cheap, local, always-on campaigns.
findings: Franchise enquiries are a high-value, unadvertised funnel: a single franchise sale is worth lakhs, and the buyer researches online first. With 11 creatives and no dedicated franchise campaign, that demand is largely organic - it should be a structured Google + Meta funnel with a numbers pack and a booking flow.

No store-radius layer: dessert cafes win on proximity and impulse. Each outlet needs a 3-5 km radius campaign with an offer and per-store measurement - starting with the highest-performing Bengaluru stores.

Lubov Patisserie gets no paid support: a premium sub-brand with its own site, no visible paid activity. It needs its own identity campaign (occasion cakes, corporate orders) rather than being folded into Frozen Bottle.

Broken footer link live: the footer points to /pages/faqs while /pages/faq returns a 404 - small, but it is the kind of defect that erodes trust at the exact moment a franchise prospect is digging deeper.
Corporate food booking is buried: offices order desserts for events - a dedicated B2B page + campaign is a low-cost, high-AOV line that currently depends on the visitor finding the page unaided.
competitors: Bigger outlet counts and stronger app presence.
Win on local: per-store radius campaigns and franchise-prospect funnels.
Systematise what they do manually: offers, UGC and reminders per outlet.
Aggressive franchise-marketing funnels with ROI maths published.
Publish unit economics + run paid franchise campaigns; that is how franchise sales scale.
wins: A 'Franchise with us' campaign: landing page with investment range, ROI illustration, support model and a booking form - plus Google search for 'milkshake franchise', 'dessert franchise opportunity' and Meta retargeting for page viewers.
Give the top 10 outlets 3-5 km radius campaigns with a store-specific offer and per-store tracking. This is the cheapest way to lift footfall and to prove the model before scaling.
WIN 3 - Give Lubov its own ad identity
Run Lubov Patisserie as a separate brand: occasion cakes, corporate orders and premium gifting, with its own creatives, landing pages and retargeting. Two brands, two engines - not one.
impact: New demand line at low cost
